about: Models recommended for the Assistant, which plans work and dispatches tasks rather than writing code. Matched by model id against the models the runtime lists. Source: WorkflowArena (arXiv 2611.12856, 2026-11-09), Table 1, which measures orchestration: a model breaks work into tasks, hands them to workers and combines the results.

assistant.label: default
assistant.evidence: WorkflowArena: 27.6% resolved at low effort (about $3.61 a task); low effort resolved more than medium or high, xhigh added 1.9 points.

assistant.label: stronger
assistant.evidence: WorkflowArena: 30.8% resolved at xhigh effort, about $29.26 a task.
